flags.statement: The November reading had been far below the −22.5 recorded a year earlier.
flags.problem: The year-earlier comparison uses the October 2025 figure. NIM’s December 19, 2025 release lists −22.5 for October 2025 and −24.1 for November 2025.

flags.statement: The leaders' backing opens the formal procedure under Article 283(2) of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU.
flags.problem: The Article 283(2) appointment procedure was already underway before the summit. In his 6 November 2026 statement, the Eurogroup president said he had started the procedure after Lagarde notified Costa on 29 October and had already received two nominations.

flags.statement: The two chambers had sent the committee irreconcilable versions.
flags.problem: The Assemblée nationale did not adopt a version of its own. It rejected the revenue section on 23 October, which sank the entire bill, so the Senate examined the government's original text rather than an Assembly version.

flags.statement: which forces a text through without a vote.
flags.problem: Article 49(3) bypasses a direct vote on the bill but does not guarantee its passage. If the Assemblée nationale adopts a motion of no confidence, the bill is rejected and the government falls.
